messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging oncall — high 5xx and sustained TPM spike for model family "falcon-family" in us-west1. Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/embed. Tail latency up to 10s, overall TPM ~2.5x baseline. No automated sculpt applied yet.
Jess (oncall): Ack — taking this. Which customers are seeing failures?
Maya (support): AcmeCorp and RideShareX reporting ~35-45% failures on embedding calls since 10:02 UTC. Several users show unusually large token counts per request.
Ravi (eng-sre): Sounds like a burst of long-context batched requests causing queueing and KV pressure. Immediate mitigation: emergency per-family RPM cap + lower TPM for falcon-family. That flattens arrival rate and protects the hot runtime path.
Jess (oncall): Agreed. Lina, can you apply an emergency sculpt now? Proposed: TPM -> 1800 and per-client RPM -> 20 for falcon-family. Also consider disabling streaming for long responses to reduce KV cache churn.
Lina (eng-runtime): On it, applying throttle now.
Lina (eng-runtime): ```shell
apictl quota set --model-family falcon-family --tpm 1800 --rpm 20 --scope emergency/incident --reason "live mitigation 1765123456"
```
deploy-bot: Rollout started: quota change for falcon-family -> tpm 1800 rpm 20. 3/3 hosts acknowledged. TraceID: r-72b9
Tom (prod-eng): Also disabling streaming for responses >5k tokens on falcon-family to lower KV and IO churn.
Tom (prod-eng): ```json
{"feature.disable_streaming":"falcon-family","threshold_tokens":5000}
```
Ravi (eng-sre): Observability update: 5xx rate dropped from 42% -> 12% within 60s. p95 latency down from 3.1s -> 1.2s. Promising signal. Continuing to monitor.
Maya (support): Confirming AcmeCorp sees retries succeeding — their error rate now ~8%.
Jess (oncall): Nice. I'll keep thread open. Plan: hold these limits for 30m then reassess. Start incident timeline and capture customer impact.
Ravi (eng-sre): We'll also create per-client soft caps for high-volume tenants to avoid repetition. Filing ticket: SRE-INC-1765 (follow-up: per-client throttling policies + batching heuristics).
Jess (oncall): Handoff note: I'll hand off in 25m if stable. Plan to incrementally raise RPM to 40 for a canary client, then to baseline if metrics stay good.
Lina (eng-runtime): Added a guard: if queue depth > 300 -> automatic streaming disable + cap offending client to 10 rpm.
incident-bot: Note added to incident timeline. Severity downgraded P1 -> P2 (mitigated). Duration so far: 00:08:30.
Tom (prod-eng): Postmortem action items: revisit batching heuristics, prefix cache TTL, and recommend a model-variant fallback (falcon-mini) for high-volume clients.
Jess (oncall): Handoff now to Ravi for the next 2 hours. Attached logs, dashboard links, and customer notes in ticket.
Ravi (eng-sre): Taking over. I'll run a canary increase to rpm=40 for one client and observe 5/10/30-min windows, then revert if any regression. Creating runbook entry for this scenario.
Maya (support): I'll update affected customers with mitigation summary and ETA for permanent fix. Thanks team :heart:
Jess (oncall): Closing out immediate actions in this thread. Follow-ups: postmortem, long-term throttling policy, and improved auto-sculpt rules.
